{{Quote|The Twin Spears are in Clan Jendri's territory. If they catch us moving in on their turf, there will be blood.|[[Veela Ordo]]|<ref name="Revan" />}}
'''Clan Jendri''' was a [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] clan in existence following the [[Mandalorian Wars]]. After the [[Battle of Malachor V|defeat]] of the [[Mandalore (title)/Legends|Mandalorian leader]], [[Mandalore the Ultimate]], at [[Malachor V]] by the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan]], and Revan's subsequent theft of [[Mandalore's Mask]], numerous Mandalorian clans set out in [[Search for Mandalore's Mask|search]] of the lost [[Armor/Legends|mask]]. By [[3954 BBY]], Clan Jendri's search had led them to the [[Water/Legends|snow]]-covered [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Rekkiad]] in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. There, the members of Clan Jendri established a territory encompassing the world's [[Twin Spears]] mountain, which they patrolled with their four [[Basilisk war droid/Legends|Basilisk war droids]]. That same [[Standard year/Legends|year]], members of the fellow Mandalorian clan, [[Clan Ordo]], moved into Jendri's territory in their own search for Mandalore's Mask. Clan Jendri [[Skirmish on Rekkiad|engaged]] Ordo for control of the area, and though they outnumbered Clan Ordo by nearly a two-to-one margin, Ordo was victorious. Having been defeated, Clan Jendri conceded the territory to the members of Clan Ordo.<ref name="Revan" />

==Behind the scenes==
Clan Jendri was first introduced to the ''[[Star Wars]]'' universe in ''[[The Old Republic: Revan]]'', a [[2011]] novel written by [[Author/Legends|author]] [[Drew Karpyshyn]].<ref name="Revan" />
